question: Which of the following is the strongest candidate for delegating to Claude within a marketing team?
options: A) Drafting first-pass social copy from an approved brief, with an editor reviewing it before anything is posted.
B) Sending the price change notices straight to customers as soon as they are generated, without any review at all.
C) Choosing which employees are promoted, based on the performance notes gathered from their managers.
D) Deciding which customers are refused credit, using the payment histories held in the finance system.
correct_answers: A) Drafting first-pass social copy from an approved brief, with an editor reviewing it before anything is posted.
explanations: Correct. Reversible, well-specified drafting with a human reviewing before release is the ideal delegation shape.
This is irreversible and externally visible, so it needs review before it goes out.
Employment decisions affect people's livelihoods and must remain a human judgment.
Credit decisions affect people's rights and finances and cannot be delegated outright.
